create.name: Giten Tonkov
create.bio:
Giten Tonkov developed BBTRS, his Biodynamic Breathwork and Trauma Release method, a body-based approach that weaves together six strands: breath, movement, sound, touch, emotion and meditation. Born in Ukraine, he spent 24 years living and working in New York City and more than a decade in India and Bali, and he now lives on the Greek island of Lesvos.

He trained first as a massage therapist and later as a breath and body-oriented therapist. The method grew out of his own long recovery from the effects of a childhood accident, during which he studied many bodywork styles, conscious movement and meditation, including the breath practices he met at the Osho centre in India. He has been teaching the resulting practice for close to twenty years and set out its story and methods in his book Feel to Heal.

He heads the Biodynamic Breathwork & Trauma Release Institute, which trains facilitators online and at residential retreats, and he co-founded sister organisations in Poland with two former students, Nisarga Dobosz and Prema McKeever; their work there includes acute-trauma training for Ukrainians displaced by the war. He also offers one-to-one sessions over Zoom, focused on noticing where stress and old trauma are held in the body and releasing that tension through breath, felt sense and movement.

books.title: Feel to Heal: Releasing Trauma Through Body Awareness and Breathwork Practice
books.author: Giten Tonkov
books.description: His account of how the Biodynamic Breathwork & Trauma Release System came about and how it works, drawing on his own recovery after a childhood accident and on the six elements of breath, movement, sound, touch, emotion and meditation that make up the practice.

courses.title: BBTRS Mexico Training Retreat
courses.description: A seven-night residential training at OZEN Holistic Retreat Center in the jungle of Quintana Roo, Mexico, facilitated by Giten Tonkov. Participants work through the six BBTRS elements in their own bodies and learn to guide trauma-informed breathwork with pacing and consent; it is open to personal-growth participants as well as trainees and counts towards advanced certification. Accommodation and meals are booked separately.
courses.price: $2150.00 USD ($1827.50 USD super early bird until December 8, 2026); accommodation from $680 USD

courses.title: Online Sessions with Giten
courses.description: One-to-one sessions with Giten over Zoom, exploring where past stress and trauma are held as tension in the body and using felt sense, focused breathing, movement and verbal support to release it.
